description: Honda PGM-FI Sensor Specifications — Layer 2 Knowledge Base

RPM.name: Engine Speed (RPM)
RPM.fault_description: 0 RPM = tidak ada sinyal CKP / mesin mati

interpretation.below_normal: RPM terlalu rendah bisa menandakan masalah idle control, sensor CKP lemah, atau mesin hampir mati
interpretation.above_normal: RPM terlalu tinggi di idle bisa disebabkan kebocoran udara intake, IACV bermasalah, atau kabel gas tersangkut
interpretation.at_fault: RPM = 0 saat mesin seharusnya hidup menunjukkan sinyal CKP hilang total

interpretation.below_normal: TPS < 0.3V saat throttle tertutup → kemungkinan sensor short circuit ke ground
interpretation.above_normal: TPS > 0.8V saat throttle tertutup → kabel gas tidak kembali sempurna, atau sensor tidak terkalibrasi
interpretation.at_fault: TPS 0V = sensor short, TPS 5V = sensor open circuit

MAP.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure
MAP.fault_description: 0 kPa (sensor fault / no vacuum) atau stuck di 100 kPa (no vacuum signal)

interpretation.below_normal: MAP < 25 kPa di idle = vacuum terlalu tinggi (bisa normal jika mesin baru service)
interpretation.above_normal: MAP > 35 kPa di idle = vacuum rendah, kemungkinan kebocoran udara intake atau piston ring aus
interpretation.at_fault: MAP 0 kPa = sensor fault / short. MAP stuck 100 kPa = hose vacuum bocor/lepas

IAT.name: Intake Air Temperature
IAT.fault_description: -40°C = open circuit (resistansi tak terhingga). 120°C palsu = short circuit

interpretation.below_normal: IAT < 25°C bisa normal di pagi hari atau cuaca dingin
interpretation.above_normal: IAT > 45°C di idle → udara masuk terlalu panas, periksa airbox dekat mesin panas
interpretation.at_fault: -40°C = sensor open circuit (konektor lepas / kabel putus). Suhu ambient tidak mungkin -40°C di Indonesia

ECT.name: Engine Coolant Temperature
ECT.fault_description: -40°C = open circuit. > 120°C = overheating atau sensor short

interpretation.below_normal: ECT < 75°C = mesin belum panas. Normal jika baru dihidupkan < 10 menit
interpretation.above_normal: ECT > 100°C = overheating! Periksa coolant level, kipas radiator, thermostat
interpretation.at_fault: -40°C = sensor open circuit. > 120°C = overheating berbahaya atau sensor short

O2.name: Oxygen Sensor (Lambda)
O2.fault_description: < 0.1V (lean stuck / sensor rusak) atau stuck > 0.9V (rich stuck)

interpretation.below_normal: O2 < 0.4V = campuran BBM cenderung kurus (lean). Jika stuck < 0.1V → sensor rusak
interpretation.above_normal: O2 > 0.6V = campuran BBM cenderung kaya (rich). Jika stuck > 0.9V → sensor rusak atau injektor bocor
interpretation.at_fault: O2 sensor seharusnya berfluktuasi antara 0.1-0.9V dalam closed loop. Jika stuck = sensor rusak
interpretation.normal_behavior: Pada closed loop, O2 sensor harus berfluktuasi cross-switching antara lean dan rich setiap 1-3 detik

BATTERY.name: Battery / System Voltage
BATTERY.fault_description: < 11V = aki lemah / charging system gagal. > 15.5V = overcharging

interpretation.below_normal: Battery < 13.5V saat mesin hidup → alternator mungkin tidak charging. < 12V mesin mati = aki lemah
interpretation.above_normal: Battery > 14.5V → regulator perlu diperiksa. > 15.5V = OVERCHARGING — bisa merusak ECU!
interpretation.at_fault: Voltage < 10V = aki dead / koneksi putus. > 16V = regulator rusak total, SEGERA MATIKAN MESIN

IACV.name: Idle Air Control Valve Position
IACV.fault_description: 0% = valve fully closed (stuck) atau 100% = valve fully open (stuck)

interpretation.below_normal: IACV < 30% = ECU mencoba menutup idle air → RPM mungkin terlalu tinggi dari sumber lain (kebocoran udara)
interpretation.above_normal: IACV > 60% = ECU membuka valve lebih banyak untuk menjaga idle → mesin mungkin kesulitan idle
interpretation.at_fault: IACV 0% dan RPM naik = kebocoran udara. IACV 100% dan RPM rendah = valve tidak bisa menambah udara (stuck)

FUEL_TRIM.name: Fuel Trim (Short Term / Long Term)
FUEL_TRIM.fault_description: > +20% = sistem terlalu kurus (ECU menambah BBM). < -20% = sistem terlalu kaya (ECU mengurangi BBM)

interpretation.below_normal: Fuel Trim negatif tinggi (< -10%) = campuran terlalu kaya. ECU mengurangi BBM. Periksa injektor bocor, filter udara, fuel pressure
interpretation.above_normal: Fuel Trim positif tinggi (> +10%) = campuran terlalu kurus. ECU menambah BBM. Periksa kebocoran udara intake, fuel delivery
interpretation.at_fault: Fuel Trim mendekati ±25% = ECU sudah mencapai batas kompensasi. Harus diperbaiki karena performa dan emisi terganggu
